brief: wave-1 piece W1-00 - Harness, determinism and persistence
findings: HARNESS.md S3 is the API contract; tools/lib/run.mjs REQUIRED_METHODS = setSeed, stepFrames, queueInputs, snapshot, traceStart, traceStop.

tools/lib/run.mjs drives: setSeed -> loadState(scenario.state) OR reset({seed}) -> setTimeOfDay/setWeather -> setup ops -> stepFrames(warmup) -> queueInputs -> traceStart -> stepFrames(chunk) + traceDrain loop -> traceStop. Game must match this order exactly.

Judging items demand harness amendments A-JRN1,3,5,6,7,8,10,11,15 (JOURNEY-CRITIC-FLEET.md S7). Without them RI-JRN03/05, RI-PLT01/03 are all 'unmeasurable = 0'. Implementing them is in scope and is the difference between 0 and a score.
RI-CAM06 requires a `camera` trace block incl. shake, mode, hitstop, roll; camera must be updated INSIDE the fixed step.
RI-PLT01 Tier-H (fps, frame times) is NOT scoreable in this container (SwiftShader). Tier-S = drawCalls, triangles, programs, materials, alloc/step, sim CPU, decoupling.

RI-JRN05: IndexedDB authoritative; localStorage banned except <=1KB pointer; write protocol = one readwrite txn over [blobs,saves,meta]; monotonic generation; A/B double buffer; digest check with gen-1 fallback.
